## 📋 Core Relocation Checklist (from the original 10‑15‑question tool)

| # | Question / Area | Why It Matters |
|---|-----------------|----------------|
| 1 | **Ideal day** – visualise your perfect coastal routine | Clarifies daily‑life fit |
| 2 | **Climate limits** – temperature, humidity, hurricane risk | Avoids health/comfort surprises |
| 3 | **Nature access** – beaches, trails, water sports | Aligns with lifestyle priorities |
| 4 | **Work flexibility** – remote‑work policy, local job market | Determines income viability |
| 5 | **Housing budget** – rent/mortgage ceiling | Filters out unaffordable areas |
| 6 | **Walkability / transit** – distance to grocery, health services | Impacts cost of living & time |
| 7 | **Community vibe** – diversity, cultural scene, social clubs | Supports long‑term satisfaction |
| 8 | **Family proximity** – closeness to relatives or support network | Influences emotional wellbeing |
| 9 | **Cultural/entertainment options** – arts, dining, events | Enriches quality of life |
|10| **Pace of life** – fast‑city vs laid‑back town | Matches personal energy rhythm |
|11| **Problems to solve** – e.g., flood risk, housing scarcity | Pre‑emptively addresses deal‑breakers |
|12| **Coastal importance weight** – how essential ocean access is | Drives weighting in scorecard |
|13‑15| **Nice‑to‑have extras** – pet‑friendly, schools, nightlife, etc. | Helps rank final options |

### How to Use the Timeline & Checklist
1. **Follow the chronological blocks** – each step builds on data collected in the previous one.  
2. **Update the scorecard continuously** – after every visit or remote‑work trial, enter the new metrics; the weighted total will guide you toward the 70 % confidence threshold.  
3. **Keep a simple spreadsheet** with columns for each metric and a “confidence” column; link it to the checklist answers for quick reference.  
4. **Review at month 12** (mid‑point) to decide whether to stay on the 2‑year plan or accelerate (if confidence > 90 %).  

By adhering to this 24‑month roadmap and the attached checklist, you’ll systematically reduce uncertainty, secure a viable job, and lock in housing—ensuring the coastal relocation is both realistic and aligned with your priorities.
